remediation.suggestion: Remove the broad updater from this lookup workflow, or require explicit approval after displaying every installation it will modify.

content.user_title: Check KBO Schedules and Game Results
content.value_statement: Finding date-specific KBO scores can require checking several game listings. This skill uses kbo-game to summarize schedules, scores, and status for a requested date.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve KBO game information for a specified calendar date using kbo-game.
Convert relative dates such as today and yesterday into explicit dates before retrieval.
Call getGame with a Date object using a Korea Standard Time offset.
Summarize home and away teams, game status, and scores.
Filter the retrieved games for a requested team.
Present compact game summaries, with raw data available separately when requested.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18+, npm, network access, and the external kbo-game package.
KBO website changes can break retrieval, and offseason dates can return no games.
The workflow installs global packages and obtains mutable CLI instructions; those external packages were not audited here.
The bundled disclaimer restricts automated collection to personal lookups, excluding organizational collection, bulk crawling, and database building.

use_cases.title: Check a daily scoreboard
use_cases.description: Review the games, scores, and current status for one requested date.

use_cases.title: Follow one team
use_cases.description: Filter a daily game listing to show only the requested team.

use_cases.title: Review a past game day
use_cases.description: Request a date-specific summary for personal baseball study without building a separate database.

prompt_templates.title: Check today's games
prompt_templates.prompt: Show today's KBO games, scores, and status. Use Korea Standard Time and state the exact date.

prompt_templates.title: Find a team's result
prompt_templates.prompt: Show yesterday's Hanwha game and score. State the exact date and whether the game has finished.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a selected date
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize KBO games for [YYYY-MM-DD], one line per game. Include home team, away team, status, and score when available.

prompt_templates.title: Handle incomplete results carefully
prompt_templates.prompt: For [YYYY-MM-DD], show only [team] games. Separate missing scores from empty results and retrieval failures. Ask before installing or updating packages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced lookup with explicit safety boundaries

output_examples.input: Show an example scoreboard format using fictional data.
output: Illustrative data only, not a retrieved result.
Home: Hanwha | Away: LG | Final | Hanwha 5, LG 3

output_examples.input: Show an example response when a date returns an empty game list.
output_examples.output: Illustrative response: No games were returned for the requested date. An empty response alone does not establish why no games appeared.

best_practices: Specify the exact date and timezone, especially for today or yesterday.
Review package sources and approve installation or updates before running external commands.
Keep requests personal and date-specific, and report retrieval failures separately from empty results.
anti_patterns: Treating missing scores as zero or inventing results after a retrieval failure.
Running broad skill updates automatically as part of a scoreboard lookup.
Using repeated lookups for bulk collection, database building, or access-control circumvention.

faq.question: What does this skill retrieve?
faq.answer: It retrieves date-specific KBO game information through kbo-game and summarizes teams, scores, and status.

faq.question: Can I request one team?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a team name with the date to filter the retrieved games.

faq.question: Does it support today and yesterday?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow converts relative dates to explicit dates before retrieval. Specify your timezone to avoid ambiguity.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: Node.js 18+, npm, and kbo-game are required. The entry instructions also invoke the external k-skill CLI.

faq.question: Why might no games appear?
faq.answer: Offseason dates can return empty results. Website changes can also break retrieval, so empty results and failures should be distinguished.

faq.question: Is this an official KBO tool?
faq.answer: No. The disclaimer states no official affiliation or approval and limits automated collection to personal, non-organizational lookups.
